page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 physical cores and 64 vCPUs, establishing a one-to-one mapping with one thread per core and no hyperthreading enabled.

This instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage, requiring the use of external network-attached storage volumes for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and there are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with the instance.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed of 3.1 GHz, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the latency variations of hyperthreaded environments. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration makes it a fit for enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, and database workloads that rely on network-attached storage and require predictable single-threaded execution per vCPU.
